items.descZh: OpenSourceHub是一个专注于提供免费、自托管开源替代品的平台，旨在帮助用户停止过度支付SaaS订阅费用，替代Google Analytics、Slack等流行工具。该平台核心功能是索引了超过488种开源工具，覆盖40多种SaaS服务，用户可通过Docker在几分钟内部署，实现快速上线。亮点包括其庞大的工具库，涵盖25个类别和20多种许可证类型，热门项目如awesomeselfhosted拥有329.1k GitHub星标、n8n有208.3k星标，体现了高社区认可度。适用场景广泛，包括文件存储、工作流自动化、AI接口、媒体管理等，适合希望节省成本并掌控数据的个人或企业。

Learn how to design systems built on large language models: the tradeoffs, the components, and the patterns that have converged across the industry, along with the ones that are still moving. [](/daneb/aisystemdesignprimer/blob/master/images/readme.svg) Motivation Learn how to design AI systems that hold up in production. Prepare for the AI system design conversation. Building on models is now a core engineering skill, and the field moves fast. Most of what's written about it is a product announcement, a framework tutorial or a single team's experience. This primer is an organised collection of what has converged across providers and researchers, with every tradeoff named and every number dated and sourced. It is modelled on Donne Martin's [System Design Primer](https://github.com/donnemartin/systemdesignprimer): the same arc of method, tradeoffs, components, solved designs and reference numbers, rebuilt for systems whose core component is probabilistic, priced per token, and open to prompt injection. Learn how to design AI systems. Each topic is a short page you can read in ten minutes, with a diagram, when to use it, when not to, and its disadvantages. A deep dive per topic holds the provider survey, numbers, risk controls and cloud mappin

ECDSA signature verification, did:key identity, nonce generation. [](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache2.0) [](https://github.com/ArkenForge/arkencore/actions/workflows/release.yml) What this is arkencore is the Rust library that everything in ArkenForge builds on. It handles: Challenge generation — cryptographically random nonces with 60s TTL Signature verification — ECDSA secp256k1 via [ethersrs](https://github.com/gakonst/ethersrs) DID parsing — did:key identity using the W3C spec (zQ3s… prefix for secp256k1) It compiles to a native shared library (.dylib / .so / .dll) loaded by higherlevel packages via FFI. Build Requires [Rust](https://rustup.rs). cd rust cargo build release Output: rust/target/release/libarken_core.{dylib,so,dll} C API Three Ccompatible functions are exported: int generate_challenge_into(const char statement, char out, int cap); int verify_request_into(const char header, char out, int cap); int verify_signature_only_into(const char header, char out, int cap); All functions write JSON into out and return the number of bytes written, or 1 on buffer overflow. How it works An unsigned request gets a 401 with a onetime nonce. The client signs the nonce with its secp256k1 private key and retries with an Authorization: Signature header. The core verifies the ECDSA signature, checks the nonce, and returns the agent's did:key — nothing stored, nothing breached. sequenceDiagram participant C as Client participant S as Server CS: GET /protected SC: 401 { challenge: { nonce, statement } } Note over C: sign(nonce, privateKey) CS: GET /protected<br/Authorization: Signature did="…",nonce="…",signature="…" SC: 200 { did: "did:key:zQ3s…" } Loading Identity: did:key Each agent gets a [W3C DID Key](https://w3cccg.github.io/didmethodkey/) derived from its key pair: did:key:zQ3shXgnkuyqVxf3NGBsK1q3J… The zQ3s… prefix indicates secp256k1 (0xe7 0x01 multicodec). Same key, same DID, across every server running Arken. One identity, every tool. ArkenForge ecosystem Repo What it is arkencore (this repo) Rust crypto core — the foundation [arkenauth](https://github.com/arkenforge/arkenauth) Express + FastAPI middleware, client SDKs, MCP integration [arkenregistry](https://github.com/arkenforge/arkenregistry) Discovery registry — find APIs that accept Arken auth [arkenverifier](https://github.com/arkenforge/arkenverifier) Hosted verifier — metered signature verification Status Not productionready. Earlystage project. Nonces are in memory. Won't survive restarts or work across multiple instances without a shared store. No key recovery. Losing the private key means losing access. Rust toolchain required to build. Prebuilt binaries are on the 1.0 roadmap. Security See [SECURITY.md](/arkenforge/arkencore/blob/main/SECURITY.md). Find a flaw, open a private advisory, and your name goes in the Hall of Finders. Join the 1.0 waitlist Founding Builders — everyone who joins before December 15, 2026 — are credited by name in the 1.0 README. There are 10 designpartner slots for teams who want to shape the API directly. items.author: arkenforge
items.descZh: arkencore是ArkenForge生态系统的Rust加密核心库，旨在通过DID签名实现无密码认证，彻底消除传统密码和会话机制带来的安全泄露风险。其核心功能包括生成具有60秒生存期的加密随机nonce、验证ECDSA secp256k1签名以及解析符合W3C标准的did:key身份，确保身份验证过程无需存储敏感数据。亮点在于采用去中心化身份方案，每个代理的密钥对直接映射到全局唯一的DID（如did:key:zQ3s...前缀），且签名验证高效可靠，适用于需要安全身份验证的API保护、微服务通信或去中心化应用。然而，项目目前处于早期阶段，nonce仅存储在内存中，不支持系统重启或多实例部署，且无密钥恢复功能。该库使用Apache 2.0许可证，并设有安全漏洞奖励计划，鼓励社区参与改进。
items.quote: 通过 DID 签名实现无密码认证。无需密码，无需会话，无泄露风险。

GhostBase 👻 A fast, keyboarddriven terminal database studio for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. _No Java runtimes. No 1.5GB RAM bloat. Builtin production safety guard, instant SQL beautifier & zeroconfig .env connect._ [](https://github.com/4yk5/GhostBase/actions) [](https://pypi.org/project/ghostbasecli/) [](https://www.python.org/) [](/4yk5/GhostBase/blob/main/LICENSE) [](https://github.com/Textualize/textual) [](/4yk5/GhostBase/blob/main/assets/ghostbase.png) ⚡ Why GhostBase? Opening DBeaver or DataGrip just to run a quick SELECT, inspect an index, or check foreign keys is painful: ❌ 1.5 GB+ RAM bloat: Heavy Java/Eclipse runtimes that spin your laptop fans. 👉 GhostBase idles at \~25 MB RAM. ❌ 15Second Cold Starts: Splash screens, driver updates, and workspace indexing. 👉 GhostBase starts in under 120 ms directly in your terminal. ❌ Accidental Destructive Queries on Production: Running DELETE or UPDATE without a WHERE clause can wipe production tables. 👉 GhostBase intercepts destructive queries automatically with doubleconfirmation and onekey ReadOnly Safe Mode (Ctrl + S). ❌ Messy, Unformatted Queries: Manually formatting and indenting long SQL statements. 👉 GhostBase autoformats and beautifies messy SQL queries with one keypress (Ctrl + B). ❌ Tedious Connection Setup: Typing credentials into multitab dialogs. 👉 GhostBase autodetects DATABASE_URL from your local .env file. ❌ Seeding & Migrating Data: Manually writing INSERT INTO statements to replicate test rows. 👉 GhostBase exports query results directly into executable SQL INSERT statements (Ctrl + I). ❌ Exporting for GitHub / Jira / Notion: Exporting CSV, then finding a website to convert to Markdown. 👉 Onekey instant Markdown table export (Ctrl + M) directly into clean GitHub Flavored Markdown. 🚀 Killer Features 🛡️ Production Safety Guard & Safe Mode (Ctrl + S): Intercepts dangerous statements (DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE). In Safe Mode, all destructive operations are strictly blocked. In normal mode, requires explicit doubleconfirmation before execution. ✨ 1Key SQL Beautifier (Ctrl + B): Instantly cleans up whitespace, capitalizes SQL keywords, and indents subclauses (FROM, WHERE, AND, OR, JOIN, ORDER BY). ⚡ 1Key Query Plan (Ctrl + P): Run instant execution plans (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN / EXPLAIN) on any query to see index usage and bottlenecks. 🔌 Universal Database Support: Connects natively to SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. 🔑 ZeroConfig .env AutoConnect: Just run ghostbase in any project folder; it automatic
items.author: 4yk5
items.descZh: GhostBase 是一款专为开发者打造的轻量级、键盘驱动的终端数据库管理工具，原生支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL，旨在替代传统重量级 GUI 工具。它拥有极致的性能表现，内存占用仅约 25 MB（远低于传统 Java 工具的 1.5 GB+ 内存占用），冷启动时间低于 120 毫秒，提供无与伦比的终端操作体验。核心亮点包括内置的生产安全防护网，能自动拦截无 WHERE 条件的 DELETE/UPDATE 等危险操作，并支持一键 SQL 美化（Ctrl+B）与一键只读安全模式（Ctrl+S），极大提升了数据库操作安全性。此外，它支持一键执行查询计划分析（Ctrl+P），并能自动识别项目中的 `.env` 文件实现零配置快速连接，完美适配快速排查问题、数据迁移与本地开发场景。它还支持将查询结果一键导出为可执行的 SQL INSERT 语句或直接生成 GitHub 风格的 Markdown 表格，是开发者日常快速查询、数据库结构检查及团队协作共享数据的高效利器。
items.quote: GhostBase 空闲时占用约 25 MB 内存。

Just deployed. Selfhosted, pushtodeploy CI/CD for PHP sites on shared hosting. [](https://github.com/YohanSandun/dodocd/releases/latest/download/dodocd.zip) [Get started](installation) · [GitHub Actions example](examplegithubactionsworkflow) · [Release notes](https://github.com/YohanSandun/dodocd/releases) The dodo didn't make it. Shared hosting did: a huge share of the web's PHP sites still runs on it. But modern CI/CD moved on to containers, SSH and build runners, and left those sites behind with FTP uploads and crossed fingers. DodoCD brings CI/CD back to them. Upload one folder to your hosting, run the setup wizard, and from then on every build from your pipeline goes live with a single request. Why DodoCD Runs where your site already lives. Plain PHP 8.1+ on Apache or LiteSpeed. No SSH, no root, no Docker, no Node on the server. Works with any CI. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins: if it can run curl, it can deploy. Deploys that don't wreck your site. Every zip is checked before it's unpacked. Only files from your previous release are ever deleted, so .env, uploads and caches stay put. If copying fails, the previous release is restored. Rollbacks from the dashboard. Your recent releases are kept, and any of them can be made live again. Database migrations. Ship .sql files in the zip. They run before any file is copied, and a failing one keeps the old release live. One dashboard for all your sites, with deploy history, full logs and persite deploy tokens. Updates itself from signed release packages, with a backup first. Coming next: database backups before migrating, and status monitoring. Requirements PHP 8.1 or newer Extensions pdo\_sqlite, zip, json, and sodium or openssl SQLite library 3.7.17 or newer (3.25+ recommended) Web server Apache with mod\_rewrite, or LiteSpeed, with .htaccess enabled Optional pdo\_mysql, needed for database migrations. curl or allow\_url\_fopen, needed to check for updates The largest zip you can deploy is limited by PHP's upload_max_filesize and post_max_size. The setup wizard checks all of this for you. Installation 1. [Download the latest dodocd.zip](https://github.com/YohanSandun/dodocd/releases/latest/download/dodocd.zip) (or a specific dodocdx.y.z.zip from the [releases page](https://github.com/YohanSandun/dodocd/releases)), unzip it, and upload the dodocd folder into your web root, e.g. as public_html/dodocd. A copy of this repository works too, but only an install made from a package lets [updates](updatingdodocd) delete files that newer versions no longer have. 2. Open https://example.com/dodocd/ in a browser. You'll be taken to the setup wizard. 3. Go through the steps: Requirements: checks the server. Red items must be fixed first. Data directory: where DodoCD keeps its database, releases and logs. The default is a folder next to your web root, e.g. /home/you/.dodocddata, so nothing in it can be downloaded. If PHP can't write there, it uses dodocd/storage and blocks web access to it. Admin account: for signing in to the dashboard. Main site: the site's URL and the folder deploys are written to, usually public_html. App database (optional): your site's MySQL database, used for [migrations](databasemigrations). It can be skipped and added later. The password is stored encrypted. Finish: installs DodoCD and shows the site's deploy token. 4. Copy the deploy token into your CI's secrets (e.g. DODOCD_TOKEN). It is shown only once, because only a hash of it is stored. If you lose it, create a new one on the site's Deploy tokens page. To run setup again, delete dodocd/agent/config.php. Any existing database is renamed to dodo.sqlite.bak<timestamp rather than deleted. Deploying POST /dodocd/api/sites/{site}/deploy Authorization: Bearer <deploy token ContentType: multipart/formdata {site} is the site's slug. Setup creates m
items.author: yohansandun
items.descZh: DodoCD 是一款专为 PHP 虚拟共享主机设计的自托管持续部署（CI/CD）工具，旨在将现代化的自动化部署能力重新带回那些缺乏 SSH 和 Docker 权限的传统共享主机环境。其核心功能是通过在网站根目录部署一个轻量级 PHP 后端，配合向导完成配置，使任何支持 curl 的 CI 系统（如 GitHub Actions、Jenkins 等）都能通过 API 触发一键部署。该工具在安全性上表现突出，所有部署包在解压前均会经过完整性校验，仅覆盖旧版本文件以保护 `.env` 和用户上传目录，并在复制失败时自动回滚至上一稳定版本。技术栈要求极为宽松，仅需 PHP 8.1+、SQLite 3.7.17+ 以及 Apache 或 LiteSpeed 服务器，无需 root 权限，且支持通过 SQL 文件实现数据库迁移。它特别适合希望在受限的虚拟主机环境中实现安全、多站点统一管理、支持快速回滚的 PHP 开发团队，让现代 CI/CD 流程在共享主机上无缝落地。
items.quote: 自托管、适用于共享托管上 PHP 站点的推送即部署 CI/CD。

items.title: Show HN: Paste your MCP config, see what each server does at startup
items.desc: description: What popular MCP servers do at startup before any tool is used, and where their own README does not name it. Published method, published evidence, not a ranking. title: What the servers on every bestof list do at startup image: https://mcp.brydgeai.com/p/index.png What the servers on every bestof list do at startup Level 1 measurement What a server did at startup before any tool was used, and where its own README is silent about it. No tool is called, so nothing here tests whether a tool does what it says. Not calibrationbacked. Not a ranking. What the servers on every bestof list do at startup 7 of 67 servers reached for a website their own README does not name Each of those 7 servers is recorded with the name it asked for and the line of its README that does not contain it. Nothing left the machine: the room has no route off the host, so every name answered to the loopback address and no connection completed. 24 servers offered a tool their README does not name — 1,143 tools were offered in total and none was called. Read that second figure with the caveat attached: this rule reads only the README that shipped in the package, so a server documenting its tools in a reference file beside it shows every tool as unnamed, and 10 of those servers have a README under three kilobytes. A large count here is a fact about the rule as much as about the package. 2 did both. The remaining 38 had nothing found, which is not the same as a clean sweep — see below. 29 more servers are measured and held back while I decide how to publish findings fairly. 67 npm packages, each measured from its name alone: installed, started in a room with no route to the internet and no real credentials, asked for its list of tools, and compared against its own README. No tool was called. Measured 20261031 to 20261102. Not calibrationbacked. The calibration behind the ten curated measurements proves the instrument catches planted claims about what a tool _did_. Level 1 calls no tool and reads each README by a stated rule rather than by a person, so nothing in that calibration speaks to these pages. A website counts as declared only if the README names it. A tool counts as documented only if the README names it as a whole word. This is not a ranking of the mostused servers. The set measured is whatever two registry searches returned, read by hand for whether each package is a server that starts without a credential. Download figures decided nothing about the order of this table, which is alphabetical by package, and four widely used servers are measured here that neither search returned at all. Nothing on this page says one server is more used, better or worse than another. items.author: DevanshKontey
items.descZh: 本文对67个主流MCP服务器在无网络隔离的沙箱环境中进行了启动行为审计，重点排查其官方README文档中未声明的隐藏活动。测试通过在无外网路由的环境中安装并启动这些服务器，捕获其实际提供的工具列表并与README进行严格的文本比对。结果显示，有7个服务器在启动时尝试访问了README未提及的网站，同时多达24个服务器提供了未在README中具名的工具（涉及总计1,143个工具），其中2个服务器同时存在这两类行为。研究指出，部分统计偏差源于判定规则仅读取打包的README文件，例如有10个服务器的README不足3KB，导致旁置文档中的工具被视作未命名。该深度测量报告为开发者和安全研究人员评估MCP服务器的透明度、防范隐式网络请求及工具滥用提供了关键的数据支持。
items.quote: 一个网站的 67 台服务器中，只有 7 台可达，而该网站自己的 README 里并没有提到这些服务器。
items.titleZh: Show HN：粘贴你的 MCP 配置，查看每个服务器在启动时的功能
